title: Hurricane Maria
description:
B-roll package of Puerto Rico Air National Guard Tech. Sgt. Luis Vega and Senior Airman Jorje Ramos both assigned to the 156 Communictions Flight, Muniz Air National Guard Base, Puerto Rico, inspecting communications rooms or damage and functionality Oct. 10, 2017. Interview with SrA Jorje Ramos
Hurricane Maria formed in the Atlantic Ocean and affected islands in the Caribbean Sea, including Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. U.S. Military assets supported FEMA as well as state and local authorities in rescue and relief efforts. (U.S. Air Force video by SrA Taylor Harrison)
keywords: ANG, Hurricane Maria, 156 Communications Flight, AIr Force, NGB, Puerto Rico
